reviews.t: Not as deep skin friendly but eh!!
reviews.x: Came on time, packaged ok. The liners aren't matte, more on the shiny side. Most the dark colors show on my deep brown skin besides the yellow pink and orange colors. I am satisfied with this purchase. I would recommend to a friend.
I love how opaque to go on. The quality is so good for an affordable price. I created gorgeous graphic liner look with ease. Definitely a must have

reviews.t: The colors don't show on skin, but drawing with them is really fun.
reviews.x: These colors are completely translucent. You can't see them on your skin at all. I tried applying several coats, but the felt tips begin irritating your skin pretty quickly. It was really disappointing. *Update* these are actually really fun to draw with and all the characters show really well on paper.
The color pigment on half of them are barely noticeable. Staying power is just ok.

These eyeliners are GORGEOUS and very pigmented! So if you’re looking for some good colored eyeliners you definitely need these ones! Ignore the bottom swatch its from this morning and it’s still there! (which shows how long lasting it is!!) love iiiit

I usually have problems with this type of felt tipped liners bleeding on my mature lids. These however so far have not done this. The colors are vivid, they don't bleed on my lids, and they last forever! The shade I used in this photo is #12 which is a deep purple (the photo does NOT do it justice). The second photo was actually something quite shocking. I had swatched some of the shades on my hand in the morning, then forgot all about it, and went about my day. reviews.t: Not for people deeper than medium olive skin
reviews.x: Yoooo the yellow didn’t even show up on my skin really lol, just looked like a highlighter tbh...same with the dark pink which is somehow lighter than the light pink?? Not super opaque but idk they’re pretty buildable so...will probs use them still. They do stay on pretty well which is tight. They’re just like marker honestly so the quality is meh

They arrived quickly! I was very surprised that the lighter colors actually showed up on my skin! The only color not visible in the pic attached is the yellow. I will say that while they are pigmented, they can be a little patchy (esp of doing graphic or winged liner). Great for the price!

reviews.t: All worked execpt one but good for darker skin tones
reviews.x: I just got home from a long weekend to these beauties!  I tried em all out & of course the last one doesnt work which was black! Gonna try again & hopefully they all work this time..  Not great for dark skin tones!

Super surprised how great these are! I bought them mainly for Halloween makeup, but I'm so impressed will use them in my regular makeup. Tested on the back of my hand when they came in, and STAYED on for 24 hours through multiple hand washings. I didn't scrub my hands, merely washed with soap and warm water. Could work better on someone with fair skin, and I haven't yet tried using a light concealer underneath to brighten the base, but the greens/ blues/ purples don't need it at all and look amazing, while pinks/ yellow/ orange are barely visible on me.  Still gave it 4 stars because even if I don't use the lighter colors, it's

reviews.t: Wonderful value, one of the best eyeliners I've ever had
reviews.x: I have had a really great experience with these eyeliners. They last a really long time, they're very easy to put on. In this picture, I've been wearing the same eyeliner with no touch-ups since 7am this morning, and it's now  8pm in the evening.  I also appreciate that on other days,  I've been able to sustain a wing all day, which I've had trouble with due to my eyes being pretty watery. Overall with 100% by again, and I'm thinking about getting a backup box. Definitely buy this eyeliner!

reviews.t: Holy Crap, some of these are very nicely pigmented!!!
reviews.x: LOVED the blue, red, and green! They are sooooo pigmented! I'm olive skinned and the yellow, and pinks do not really show up. I really enjoy how long they last! I can only remove with makeup removal or baby oil, not water and soap/facewash.

The color isnt very vibrant and they take so many strokes to finally get any color to shine through. The yellow doesn't show up on my skin at all. They dry out far too quickly trying to apply it. Not very happy with my purchase..
These are utter trash. I’m pretty sure it’s a highlighter that they just marketed as an eyeliner. Literally looks like a highlighter/marker line that you can barely see and has no pigment. Terri le
Really bad product was missing eyeliners and one of them didn’t even work. I was super excited when they arrived, but it was a completely disappointing when I tried to use them and didn’t it work.
At first I thought they would be easy to use and they do go on easy but they did not last, and not all of the colors had any color at all. I would not buy again won't use them.
These eyeliners are HORRIBLE when it comes to pigment.  No matter how many layers I applied the yellow, orange,  and pink would show through and im about Tan skin tone.
Beautiful colors, pigmented... except the yellow one... its very sheer :( but overall loved all the colors! Does it wash off easily! Big plus! But easy to take off.
I love everything about this product. The range of colors and the long wear. Also it made me step outside the box and use colors I've never used before.

reviews.t: Its NOT BAD but it’s NOT GREAT
reviews.x: Its not bad but its NOT GREAT! For the price its ok  it looks and feel like you writing on your skin with a marker !
If you are black save your money please it doesn’t not show up on skin

Does not wash off with just water, you will want a cleanser or makeup remover. I on occasion have watery eyes, or itchy eyes and mess with my eyes now and then, and these eyeliners do not budge. claims.text: Many reviewers find the liners highly pigmented and vivid, especially the darker shades.
Several reviewers report that lighter colors like yellow and pink barely show up, particularly on deeper or olive skin tones.
Reviewers frequently praise the long-lasting, waterproof staying power.
Some reviewers find the colors patchy, translucent, or requiring multiple strokes, and note the felt tips can irritate skin or dry out.
Many reviewers consider them great value for the affordable price.
